industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Timah Resources Limited
summary: Timah Resources Limited, through its subsidiary, Mistral Engineering Sdn Bhd., generates biogas renewable energy in Australia and Malaysia. It owns and operates a biogas power plant with approximately 3.5 megawatts located in Sabah, Malaysia. The company is based in Sandakan, Malaysia. Timah Resources Limited is a subsidiary of Cash Nexus (M) Sdn. Bhd.
